div.div:

• uq_documents_sha256 UNIQUE (sha256), one row per file content

Checks
• positive_size: size_bytes > 0
• positive_pages: page_count IS NULL OR page_count > 0

div.div:
Indexes
• ix_ingestion_jobs_status_lease_expires_at (status, lease_expires_at)
• ix_ingestion_jobs_document_id_created_at (document_id, created_at)
• uq_ingestion_jobs_document_id_active UNIQUE (document_id) WHERE status <> 'failed', one live job per document
• ix_ingestion_jobs_pending_created_at (created_at, id) WHERE status = 'pending', claim order
Checks
• valid_status: pending, processing, completed, failed
• valid_stage: NULL or extracting, describing_figures, building_units, embedding, indexing, finalizing
• valid_failure_code: NULL or encrypted_document, corrupt_document, no_extractable_text, provider_unavailable, interrupted_repeatedly, internal_error
• attempt_in_range: 0 <= attempt <= max_attempts
• progress_in_range: pages_done >= 0 and <= pages_total
• failure_iff_failed: failure_code is set exactly when status = 'failed'
Defaults
• pages_done 0, attempt 0
Trigger
• ingestion_jobs_notify AFTER INSERT FOR EACH ROW runs notify_ingestion_job(), which calls pg_notify('ingestion_jobs', NEW.id) to wake the worker

text.tspan: (document_id) WHERE status <> 'failed', one live job per
• failure_iff_failed: failure_code is set exactly when status =
• ingestion_jobs_notify AFTER INSERT FOR EACH ROW runs

div.div:
Indexes
• uq_extracted_elements_document_id_reading_order UNIQUE (document_id, reading_order)
• ix_extracted_elements_document_id_page (document_id, page)
Checks
• valid_kind: heading, paragraph, list_item, caption, table, image, page_furniture
• valid_origin: text_layer, recognized
• valid_description_status: NULL or described, skipped, not_described
• ordered_box: bbox_left < bbox_right AND bbox_top < bbox_bottom
• confidence_in_range: NULL or 0 to 1
• positive_page: page >= 1
Defaults
• labels '[]', unverified_identifiers '[]', is_decorative false
Keys
• id is a deterministic uuid5 of the document sha256 and the element key

div.div:
Legend
• Solid line with crow's foot: Foreign key, many rows to one, ON DELETE CASCADE
• Dashed line: Logical link held in a payload or a storage key, no database constraint
• Markers: PK primary key, FK foreign key, UQ part of a unique constraint, NULL nullable (every other column is NOT NULL)
• Enumerations are VARCHAR columns guarded by CHECK constraints, there are no PostgreSQL ENUM types
• TIMESTAMPTZ stands for TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE

text.tspan: • Solid line with crow's foot: Foreign key, many rows to one, ON
• Dashed line: Logical link held in a payload or a storage key, no
• Markers: PK primary key, FK foreign key, UQ part of a unique
constraint, NULL nullable (every other column is NOT NULL)
• Enumerations are VARCHAR columns guarded by CHECK
constraints, there are no PostgreSQL ENUM types
• TIMESTAMPTZ stands for TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE

div.div:
Point id
• Retrieval unit id, a deterministic uuid5 of the document sha256 and the unit key
Vectors
• dense: Passage embedding, 1024 dimensions by default, cosine distance
• bm25: Sparse vector computed server-side by Qdrant (qdrant/bm25, no stemming, no stop words), IDF modifier
Payload indexes
• document_id (uuid), unit_type (keyword), pages (integer), visible (bool)
Visibility
• Points are written with visible = false and set to true when their job completes. Searches filter on visible = true
Boxes
• page, left, top, right, bottom of each source element

• bm25: Sparse vector computed server-side by Qdrant (qdrant/bm25,
